mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it reflects a tighter monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal a monetary policy response to high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to reduced real economic growth and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.3% and CPIAUCSL > 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (where unemployment is low), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns, as it reflects weaker labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically precedes reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening of consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100 and RSAFS < 440000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic economic recovery phase (characterized by rising industrial production), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.0 signals a potential setback in the recovery, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 106.0 during the post-pandemic recovery phase.
